name: NetPulse Local v2.4 — Engineering WBS
desc: Updated NetPulse Local v2.4 WBS and QA gates. Adds graceful shutdown, a telemetry history API contract, and clarified acceptance criteria for idempotency, Wi-Fi roaming, consent lifecycle, capability logging, and CSV precision. Phase 1 restart tests use a deterministic fake job runner because speedtest and ISP probe routes arrive in later phases.

cards.name: [1.1.1 - 1.1.2] Localhost Hardening & Boot Token Auth Middleware
cards.desc: Implement FastAPI security middleware to prevent DNS rebinding, CSRF, and unauthorized local process access per Section 9.1.

cards.name: [1.1.3 - 1.1.4] ULID Trace ID Middleware & Dual-Clock Utilities
cards.desc: Implement contextvars ULID trace_id propagation '(^tr_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$/)' and enforce UTC wall clock vs. time.monotonic() separation per Section 11.1 & 11.2.

cards.name: [1.2.1 - 1.2.3] SQLite WAL Schema, Rollup Workers & 500MB Quota Pruning
cards.desc: Initialize SQLite WAL database, 3,600-sample RAM ring buffer, 1m/daily rollup jobs, and non-blocking PRAGMA incremental_vacuum pruning per Section 5 & Section 8.

cards.name: [1.2.4] Persistent Idempotency Store & Restart Reconciliation
cards.desc: Implement SQLite-backed idempotency with explicit job status, a 15-minute terminal TTL and startup reconciliation per Section 7.3. Phase 1 uses a fake job runner; verify endpoint replay in Phases 3 and 4.

cards.name: [1.3.1 - 1.3.3] Split-Target Prober & Module A Diagnostic Truth State Machine
cards.desc: Build async Gateway/External/TCP:443/DNS probers and 5-state finite state machine (HEALTHY -> SUSPECT -> ACTIVE_FAULT -> RECOVERING -> RESOLVED) per Section 3.

cards.name: QA Gate: Phase 1 Automated Acceptance Suite (Gates 1-7)
cards.desc: Run automated Phase 1 gates for the diagnostic FSM, persistent idempotency via a fake job runner, quota pruning, localhost security, trace propagation, monotonic timing, and graceful shutdown/restart.

cards.name: [2.1.1 - 2.1.2] Startup Capability Matrix & Unprivileged ARP/TCP Fallbacks
cards.desc: Build startup self-check exposing GET /api/system/capabilities and implement TCP:443 SYN + ARP neighbor cache fallbacks when raw ICMP is unavailable per Section 4.

cards.name: [2.2.1 - 2.2.2] Cross-Platform Wi-Fi Telemetry Scrapers & Composite Rollup
cards.desc: Implement Windows (netsh), macOS (wdutil/system_profiler), and Linux (nmcli/iw) parsers with composite (ts_minute, bssid) primary keys and wifi_metrics_unavailable fallback.

cards.name: QA Gate: Phase 2 Degraded-Mode & Mid-Minute Roaming Tests
cards.desc: Verify unprivileged container startup (exit 0 + capability flags) and mid-minute BSSID roaming persistence without PK overwrite.

cards.name: [3.1.1 - 3.1.3] Ookla Speedtest CLI, Bufferbloat & 2.00 Mbps Idle Guardrail
cards.desc: Integrate Speedtest CLI JSON runner (with chunked HTTPS fallback), 250ms loaded ping sampler, and 2.00 Mbps active-traffic deferral check.

cards.name: [3.2.1] Backpressure WebSocket Broadcaster & Precision Serializer
cards.desc: Implement bounded asyncio.Queue(maxsize=10) drop-oldest delivery per WebSocket client and shared numeric serialization for REST, WebSocket, and CSV output per Section 11.3.

cards.name: [3.2.3] Single-Page Web Dashboard (HTML5 / Tailwind / Chart.js)
cards.desc: Build the dashboard, dominant-BSSID roaming chart, cursor-paginated events, and telemetry and displayed-events-page CSV exports per Sections 5.1 and 11.5.

cards.name: QA Gate: Phase 3 Backpressure, Idle Guardrail & Precision Parity
cards.desc: Validate stalled WS client queue cap (10 frames), 5.00 Mbps traffic deferral, and exact decimal parity across REST, WS, and CSV exports.

cards.name: [4.1.1 - 4.1.3] Module E Informed Consent, Domain Allowlist & Monotonic Cooldowns
cards.desc: Build Module E consent modal/persistence gate, strict public domain allowlist validator, max_concurrent_jobs=1 lock, and 15-minute monotonic cooldown.

cards.name: [4.2.1 - 4.2.3] DoH Tampering, TLS SNI Reset & Userspace wireproxy VPN Diff
cards.desc: Implement UDP DNS vs. DoH comparator, TLS ClientHello SNI probe, 15-hop TCP traceroute, and capped (25MB/10MB) userspace wireproxy throughput comparison.

cards.name: QA Gate: Phase 4 Consent, Allowlist & Monotonic Cooldown Clock-Step
cards.desc: Verify 403 CONSENT_REQUIRED, 422 INVALID_TARGET_DOMAIN, 409 Conflict concurrency, and 429 cooldown integrity under +2h wall-clock step.

cards.name: [5.1.1 - 5.1.2] System Tray App & Least-Privilege OS Service Wrappers
cards.desc: Build pystray tray icon with http://127.0.0... launcher, package standalone binaries, and configure unprivileged systemd/LaunchAgent/Windows Task services.

cards.name: [5.2.1 - 5.2.2] Code Signing Pipelines & Ed25519 Rollback Supervisor
cards.desc: Set up Authenticode, Apple Notarization, and GPG release signing; build Ed25519 manifest verifier and 30-second health-check rollback watchdog.

cards.name: QA Gate: Phase 5 Corrupt Update Rollback & End-to-End Trace Linkage
cards.desc: Stage crashing update binary to verify 30s rollback + hash quarantine, and validate end-to-end tr_<ULID> correlation across WS, logs, and CSV.

cards.name: [1.2.5] Graceful Shutdown & Restart Recovery
cards.desc: Implement application-lifecycle shutdown with a 10-second total deadline, WebSocket notification, child-process cleanup, SQLite close, and restart reconciliation per Section 5.4. Validate supported Unix and Windows service-stop paths.

cards.name: [3.2.2] Telemetry History REST Contract & Endpoint
cards.desc: Implement the Section 7.8 GET /api/telemetry contract, including explicit UTC range, granularity, tier retention, response shapes and 1,000-point limit.
